title: Smooth dimension strata and the sheaf of smooth complex functions
statement: Let $N$ be a topological space. A smooth structure with locally varying finite dimension consists of pairwise disjoint open sets $N_n\subseteq N$ ($n\in\mathbf N$) covering $N$, together with a smooth real $n$-manifold structure without boundary [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold] on each $N_n$. No separation or countability is included. Thus dimension is locally constant and may differ between connected components. For open $U\subseteq N$, set $\mathcal E_N(U)=\prod_{n\in\mathbf N}C^\infty(U\cap N_n,\mathbf C)$, with pointwise addition and multiplication and componentwise restriction. Complex addition and multiplication are smooth as real maps; the above presheaf is a sheaf of unital rings on the open-subset site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. A family of functions on the disjoint open cover is identified with its unique function $U\to\mathbf C$, so this is exactly the sheaf of smooth complex-valued scalar functions.

source.place: I §1 (smooth coordinate atlases); IV §4 Example (4.12), p.204; componentwise assembly as in lem-sfb-smooth-function-modules-acyclic proof step 2. Read online https://www-fourier.univ-grenoble-alpes.fr/~demailly/manuscripts/agbook.pdf.
